Additional responsibilities include:
 · Analyze, define and document requirements for data, workflow, and logical processes and interfaces with other systems
 · Ensure that expected application performance levels are achieved by coordinating, coding, testing, implementation and documentation 

 · Design, develop, and code end-to-end technology solutions to business requirements 

 · Conduct system analysis and work estimate for new tasks 

 · Write high level and low level design documents 

 · Conduct peer code reviews 

 · Prepare deliverables such as source to target mappings and transformation rules documentation 

  To succeed in this role you will need the following: 

 · Extensive experience in PL/SQL development experience with Oracle database
 · Need Strong UNIX Experience 

 · Strong knowledge of database concepts and database design 

 · Experience writing complex SQL queries by using advanced SQL functions
 

 Experience writing complex PL/SQL stored procedures and stored functions
 · Knowledge/understanding of business/functional requirements 

 · Demonstrated ability to adjust to changing priorities and handle multiple tasks simultaneously 



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
